recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16610; future Patient $everything wording changes should be made in the Admin Incubator source if that external definition changes.
issue_request: FHIR-16610 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration technical correction for the Patient Operations tab link to Patient $everything. The reported text used "mimimum" and referenced DAF; the final resolution said the text would be updated to reflect the US Core reference.
initial_application: Commit ef22a35e358a065db276f56ac53597bc8a608755, "fixed typos GF#16608,16610,16611", explicitly named GF#16610 and changed the Patient $everything description from the DAF link to a linked US-CORE reference. Commit 9e75eb3795fde681b5809e83f51f02ebbebd2131 then changed the same sentence from "at a mimimum" and linked US-CORE to "at a minimum" and "US Core Implementation Guide" without a hyperlink.
additional_context: Patient remains active in source/fhir.ini, but source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml now includes only Patient-match and Patient-purge. Commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc moved PA operations out of core by deleting source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-everything.xml and removing the Patient-everything list entry. Current core pages that mention Patient/$everything link to the Admin Incubator OperationDefinition, whose description has "At a minimum" and no stale DAF reference. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published empty no-change audit commit 97732242a573a706386a6318717f0422cb162179. No source hunk was appropriate because the requested Patient $everything correction was applied before the operation moved out of core, and the current core build has no authoritative Patient $everything OperationDefinition to edit.
